During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] soldiers [[Vildar Blin]] and his '''assistant''' stormed out of the [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] defensive trenches to attack a downed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]]. However, a Rebel [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] destroyed the downed AT-AT just as Blin and his assistant reached the [[Walker/Legends|walker]], and both were killed in the resulting explosion.
